name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A free add-on that turns an AI coding assistant into an experienced security researcher who knows how real hackers have found bugs before, so it can hunt for vulnerabilities in websites and apps.
buyer: An independent bug-bounty hunter or small security consultancy who wants to triage more targets per week without hiring additional junior pentesters.
business_use_cases: A freelance bug bounty hunter uses it to run faster, more thorough recon and vulnerability triage across more HackerOne programs per week.
A small penetration-testing boutique uses the enterprise attack matrices (M365, Okta, SharePoint) to speed up authorized client engagements.
A security training company builds a paid bootcamp teaching students to use AI-assisted bug hunting responsibly, using this as the toolkit.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'managed bug hunting' retainer service for startups, using this toolkit to find vulnerabilities before attackers do
Sell a curated, updated 'premium' version with more report patterns and CVE chains kept current

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'one-day AI-assisted security triage' service to small SaaS startups who can't afford a full pentest, using this toolkit under a signed authorization agreement — legitimate and buildable this weekend.
